newsitem.title: USA: Toddler in unlocked apartment while search was on.
newsitem.headline: Toddler in unlocked apartment while search was on.

text.p: A 2-year old toddler whose early morning disappearance sparked a massive search effort in Fredericksburg, Va., Saturday and Sunday spent the weekend drawing with crayons on the walls of an unlocked apartment in the complex where he lived with his parents.

Investigators believe Dacota Hill wandered out of his parents' third-floor apartment in the early morning hours of Saturday and found an unlocked apartment on the first floor of the complex, where he tore through a roomful of toys, hurled ink, drew on the walls and munched on cat food, according to local television and newspaper reports.
Dacota appeared hungry but unharmed on the sidewalk on Sunday, running into his father's arms.
His emotional mother, Lea Hill, told reporters Monday the active little boy was safe, healthy and "as ornery as ever."
"I don't know whether to hug him or ground him for the rest of his life," she added.
